title: Media Interest
description: What people watch and hear in the last 30 days. Data stays for 30 days.

panels.title: Watch time
panels.description: Time that Jellyfin streams played, not paused. Audio also counts. Sampled each 30 seconds.

panels.title: Roon scrobbles
panels.description: Plays from Roon, through last.fm. Counts start when the exporter starts.

panels.title: Top directors
panels.description: Uses the first director of each title.

panels.title: Top studios
panels.description: Uses the first studio of each title.

panels.title: Top genres
panels.description: Uses the first genre of each title.

panels.title: Watch time by person over time
Top artists
panels.description: Plays in the last month, as last.fm counts them. The dashboard time range does not change this panel.

panels.title: Top albums
panels.description: Plays in the last month, as last.fm counts them.

panels.title: Top tracks
panels.description: Plays in the last month, as last.fm counts them.

panels.title: Recent Roon plays
panels.description: Plays that last.fm reported. A restart of the exporter can repeat the last 100 plays.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (title) (count_over_time({container="app-jellyfin"} |= "started playback of" | regexp "User (?P<user>.+?) started playback of '(?P<title>.*)' \\((?P<client>[^)]*)" [$__range])))
topk(15, sum by (user) (count_over_time({container="app-jellyfin"} |= "started playback of" | regexp "User (?P<user>.+?) started playback of '(?P<title>.*)' \\((?P<client>[^)]*)" [$__range])))
topk(15, sum by (client) (count_over_time({container="app-jellyfin"} |= "started playback of" | regexp "User (?P<user>.+?) started playback of '(?P<title>.*)' \\((?P<client>[^)]*)" [$__range])))
{container="app-jellyfin"} |= "started playback of" | regexp "User (?P<user>.+?) started playback of '(?P<title>.*)' \\((?P<client>[^)]*)" | line_format "{{.user}}: {{.title}} ({{.client}})"
